notes.title: v1.0.8 - The Combat Update!
notes.notes:
[p]The Combat update is here! Bringing a bunch of new functional blocks and the last shape tutorial level!

Full Changelog:

[b]New Additions[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Added the GUN block![/b] Attach this block to a rotating tracker or moving player tracker for some cool results![/p][/*][*][p][b]Added the Rotating Player Tracker![/b] This block is similar to the moving Player Tracker, but instead it rotates toward the player.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added the Appearing Block![/b] This block will be invisible by default, but a signal can be specified to make it show up.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added the Delay Signal block![/b] With this logic block you can set an input, an output signal and a delay between the two. I've found this type of operation to be pretty useful while making tutorial levels.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added the Timed Signal block![/b] This block will loop between an enabled and disabled state sending an output signal only when it's enabled.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added the Ability Gain Portal! [/b]This portal (I know, bad name choice, they're more like gates) will reset your ability cooldown when passed through. Useful when combined with the new "infinity" cooldown.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added a tutorial level for the circle![/b] This can be found in the demo levels section next to the other tutorials. This time I've added a handful of secrets and a little teaser for the campaign![/p][/*][*][p][b]Added a new "Player Health" option[/b] in the level settings! By default this is now set to 3, but old levels are unaffected and will stay at 1.[/p][/*][/list][p]

[b]Changes[/b]
[/p][list][*][p][b]Added a "Target Player" option in the inspector for both player trackers.[/b] This is so that the trackers know which player to track in multiplayer. By default this is set to 1, meaning the host, but can be set to any other number, including 0 which will set it track every player locally. (So the effect will be unsynced)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ability cooldowns can now be set to infinity![/b] This means you will not recharge your ability automatically at all. Slide the slider to the max setting to enable this. Useful when combined with the new [b]Ability Gain Portals![/b] [/p][/*][*][p] [b]Updated editor visuals for the [i]Automator[/i] block[/b] and the [b][i]Text Area[/i] block[/b] to increase visibility.[/p][/*][/list][p]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[/p][list][*][p][b]NOT Gates now work again! [/b]I accidentally broke them last update, they should be fixed now.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed the typing animations not pausing[/b] when the game was paused.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed demo level thumbnails not showing up[/b] [b]for new players. [/b]That one's pretty bad, thankfully this should only have been a bug for about two days.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.0.7 - The NPC Update!
notes.notes:
[p]The NPC update is here! Bringing new blocks, streamlining of the menu, another tutorial level, and of course, NPC's !

Full Changelog:

[b]New Additions[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Added the NPC block![/b] These guys can be tweaked to say something before and after a signal, with special animations! There are currently 11 different shapes to choose from, but more will be added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added the Dash Magnet block![/b] Click and hold with the circle selected to dash (through walls!) toward this block instantly![/p][/*][*][p][b]Added the Player Tracker block![/b] This block will move along it's axis/rail to be in line with the player. Link this block with other blocks for some cool results! Individual settings can be tweaked in the inspector, as usual.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added a tutorial level for the triangle![/b] This can be found in the new demo levels section next to the other tutorials.[/p][/*][*][p][b]There is now a proper loading screen[/b] when launching the game, and mini loading popups in between level changes.[/p][/*][*][p]The Text Area block now has a new option to enable [b]a typing animation.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]

[b]Changes[/b]
[/p][list][*][p][b]ALL SIGNALS ARE NOW TEXT![/b] Already placed blocks are unaffected, so all old levels should still work, if they don't, let me know in the Discord server.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Custom levels now show up in the level selector in order of last modified![/b] This should make it much easier to navigate the level selector once you start getting a lot of levels.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Downloaded levels show up in order of most recently downloaded, [/b]like with custom levels. This is still experimental, so if it doesn't seem to work correctly, please let me know in the Discord server![/p][/*][*][p][b]The main menu has been updated[/b] to be much easier to navigate, especially for new players. Buttons that cannot be used in specific tabs are now fully hidden from view, and the "subscribe" button has been renamed to "download" and made lager as to avoid confusion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Creating a new level will instantly send you to the level editor[/b] after prompting you to give your level a name.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Demo/tutorial level select screen has been updated.[/b] This was necessary due to the updated logic to order levels by most recent, so I decided to overhaul the demo screen to make it clearer and more organized.[/p][/*][/list][p]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[/p][list][*][p][b]Lobby members are now scanned more often[/b] in multiplayer (every 10 seconds -> every 2 seconds). This should make checking the lobby player list more reliable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added 1 second input delay[/b] [b]after dispatch[/b] to prevent accidental non submitted speedrun times.[/p][/*][*][p][b]You can no longer stand on red blocks[/b] for more than 1 second if you have low FPS. (this one was kind of funny)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Switching gravity as a triangle no longer slows the speedrun timer.[/b] (lol)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.0.6 - Quality of Life changes
notes.notes:
A quick Quality of Life update while I'm working on Logic part 2, contains some changes, bugfixes and the addition of a new block!

Full Changelog:

[b]New Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the Caution Tape block! You can use the inspector transform options to get some cool results with this
[*] Added a difficulty indicator on all level widgets. You can assign a difficulty to your level by adding it as a tag
[*] Added a third difficulty option: [i]Impossible[/i]
[*] Added a "most ram sticks" indicator on the leaderboard for players who have collected the most ram sticks out of all entries, even if they don't have the fastest time
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Allowed setting scale of blocks in the inspector to negative values down to -4. This allows you to make blocks smaller.
[*] Changed the way linked blocks work. You can now move the parent block anywhere without having to worry about child blocks overlapping with other world blocks. It's a little finicky but should allow for some more freedom in level creation.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the purple selection area would display behind "lab" blocks
[*] Fixed a bug where the dynamic menu option would only update when the game restarted
[*] Fixed a bug where the player would spin exponentially faster the lower the screen's FPS
[*] Fixed a bug where if the reset button would be pressed before any checkpoint was reached you could get insanely low times
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.5 - The Logic Update! (Part One)
notes.notes:
I noticed some players were building their own logic gates with automators and triggers, so I thought it was time for a logic update! This update is split into two parts. In part one it's mostly the essentials like the new Logic Gate block, and some very important bug fixes. Part two will contain more whole reworks of things like the inspector and the addition of a random signal block!

Full Changelog:

[b]New Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Added logic blocks! With the new [i]Logic Gate block [/i] and the [i]NOT Gate Block[/i], You can now do standard computer operations using input and output signals
[*] Added the [i]Text Display Block[/i], a very straightforward text block to communicate information in your levels
[*] Added the [I]Color Display Block[/i]. This block will set its color to a specified RGB value (in the inspector) when it receives a signal
[*] Added the second tutorial level! This level will teach new players about the basics of the square's abilities
[*] Added Ram count to leaderboard entries
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed Steam badges on subscribed level buttons (they would naturally be Workshop content)
[*] Fixed a bug where pressing C while in the text edit section of the inspector would unfocus the text editor
[*] Fixed a bug where author names wouldn't appear when pressing level buttons for the first time
[*] Made thumbnail loading 1000x faster!
[*] Fixed some issues where the rich presence wouldn't update correctly
[*] Made the motion sickness settings clearer and strengthened their effects
[/list]

Feel free to mention any bugs you find, or content you'd like added in the Discord server!

notes.title: New Additions & Multiplayer Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
While working on the new tutorial levels, I felt some things were missing. So I added them!

[b]New Additions[/b]

[list]
[*]Added the [i]reset gate[/i], which will set gravity back to normal and delete all square clones when passed by the player
[*]Added the [i]force shape gate[/i], which will automatically shapeshift the player to a shape specified in the inspector
[*]Added a slider in the editor level settings to change the shape ability cooldown time
[*]Added an achievement for when upload your first level
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]

[list]
[*]Updated the cursor in the editor to keep displaying position and block name even when a block is selected to be placed. This is to help better differentiate between placed blocks and selected blocks
[*]Tweaked the controls when the gravity is switched and 'no camera rotation' is set to off
[*]Rebound move controls from the arrow keys to the numpad arrows to avoid confusion - players aren't supposed to use the arrow keys because the game makes heavy use of the mouse cursor. Lefties can still play, using the numpad arrows instead (I'm not sure how this change will work out, I'll change it back if people don't like it)
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where clicking 'cancel' on the selection tools in the editor would select the block behind the cancel button (oops)
[*]Fixed a bug where Steam Workshop thumbnails would be wrongly assingned when quickly switching between tabs
[*]Fixed a major bug where you couldn't join a friend lobby if the level name was different on both sides
[*]Fixed a bug where 'reset to last checkpoint' would only work half the time
[/list]

Please feel free to post any bugs and/or feedback in the Discord server, or reply to this update!

notes.notes:
